svg.title: buckets inspect shows the bucket graph
svg.desc: The inspect page of a shop project with 31 buckets, in a green CRT monitor. The left column lists the buckets with their file counts and pending badges. The center shows the dependency graph in focus mode on payments: checkout and returns above it, events, http-client, log and money below. The details panel on the right shows the purpose of payments, its files, its public file with each export and the buckets that use it, and its dependencies with their reasons.
